description: We are a group of enthusiastic students who share a passion for science, space exploration, and innovation. Our team is built on teamwork, creativity, and the desire to learn. We believe that every great idea starts with curiosity and cooperation. Through this challenge, we aim to develop our skills, overcome challenges, and turn our creative ideas into reality. We are beginners, but we are ready to explore, experiment, and achieve something meaningful together.
summary:
Cosmic Clean Up is an educational space mission game designed to raise awareness about the growing problem of space debris in Earth’s orbit.

In the game, players take control of an existing spacecraft and complete missions to detect, track, approach, and capture space debris using different spacecraft systems and collection tools.

The project combines space science with interactive gameplay, allowing players to understand the challenges of orbital debris removal through an engaging experience.

Our main goal is to make learning about space debris more accessible and enjoyable while highlighting the importance of protecting Earth’s orbital environment and keeping space safer for future missions.
details:
Cosmic Clean Up is an interactive space mission game where players control a spacecraft on a mission to clean up space debris orbiting Earth. Players must detect, track, and capture floating debris using different spacecraft systems and tools, such as cameras, radar, and robotic arms or capture nets.

The game aims to raise awareness about the growing problem of space debris and show how technology can help make space safer. Through fun challenges and missions, players can explore the importance of protecting Earth’s orbit while learning more about space technology.
